description: This file implements a specialized service class for interacting with Perplexity's Large Language Model (LLM) API. It extends a base OpenAI-compatible LLM service to handle Perplexity's token reporting quirks, providing methods for building request parameters and processing token usage metrics during streaming responses.

classes.name: PerplexityLLMService
classes.description: A subclass extending OpenAILLMService to implement support for Perplexity's LLM API, particularly managing incremental token usage reporting during streaming.

methods.description: Overrides parent method to process LLM context while accumulating token usage metrics incrementally during streaming.

methods.description: Overrides parent method to accumulate token counts during streaming responses, only reporting total at the end.
